bindings: 9.1 phaseGate bindings: decide.requireTwoOptions rejects <2 scored options for kind:derived; ClassificationCheck correctedKind==null iff agreed. Deferred to 10.1 (C-029): classify question-path archiveRun; conductor_decide isHumanTerritory ask-gate integration.

assertions.text: conductor_classify dispatches classifier + skeptic on the fake SDK (schema-constrained CLASSIFICATION/CLASSIFICATION_CHECK); disagreement escalates to the stricter kind (work>trivial>question); run.json embeds the check; correctedKind null iff agreed
a trivial classification synthesizes its one §2.4 item from classification.trivialItem (title/acceptance/ponytail), creates the §2.5 PENDING runtime item, advances to EXECUTING
a trivial classification escalates to work on any §2.4 violation: fileScope>trivialMaxFiles; behavioral with empty testScope; behavioral:false intersecting behavioralPaths
conductor_status renders read-only (open questions + item dispositions); mutates zero persisted bytes
conductor_decide appends the §2.7 record; rejects <2 scored options for kind:derived (requireTwoOptions) BEFORE persist; journals decision.recorded
conductor_surface writes questions.jsonl + blocks every named item; the run continues on the rest; journals
conductor_answer clears exactly the bound items (delegated to questions.answerQuestion, clear-first-then-mark), marks answered, journals
conductor_defer sets deferred + a §2.7 decision record; report's precondition (legalTools isSettled) accepts the deferred item as settled
